title: The Letter of the Cape Route
author: Ines Galloway
blurb: Astrid Nystrom, a pearl diver's child indentured to a trading company, believes history happens to other people, elsewhere. But when the army requisitions the town and the ledger with all the names, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must get the truth on the record ahead of the victors' historians, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
